newsitem.title: FRANCE: Building activity seen falling in France.
newsitem.headline: Building activity seen falling in France.

text.p: Construction activity in France should fall by one to two percent this year in constant francs following a 3.6 percent decline in 1996, the Housing Ministry said on Thursday.
The decline was expected despite an anticipated increase in construction of individual housing units, highways and housing repairs, a ministry report said.

"Despite low interest rates, construction activity in 1997 is being hurt by a lack of private-sector investment in capacity and by national and local government budgetary restraints," the report said.
